> Fact From Story: “We have learnt to greatly respect Argentina."
> > Fact From Story: They have a rich history of overachieving at the World Cup and have done a fantastic job to get here at the same level we are, so it is going to be a heck of a game.”

> > > Fact From Story: Cheika has maintained that his Los Pumas side was too tight earlier in the tournament but has begun to free themselves up since qualifying for the knockout stages – and rewarding their fans by doing so. | Fact From Story
> > > Fact From Story: Cheika however was happy to remind the All Blacks who were favourites. | Fact From Story
> > > Commonsense Knowledge: A team that has freed themselves up since qualifying for the knockout stages is a team that has improved their play. | Commonsense Knowledge
> > Commonsense Knowledge: A team's history of overachieving and their performance in a tournament are reasons to respect them.
> Commonsense Knowledge: Respecting a team means acknowledging their strengths and accomplishments.
